author: Spiczy
body:
IGN: DrippinInFlex
Discord(ex. Name#1234):Sᴘɪᴄᴢʏ( נɪᴘʜʏ)#5823
Timezone: Central or GMT+6
Why would you like to join the referee team(brief paragraph):I would like to be a part of the referee team because I was a previous ref on my Jiphy account. My main motive for becoming a referee is to emphasize that players should play by the rules and not complying to them. I want everyone on the server to have an enjoyable time on Avicus. I want the server to be safe from rule-breakers and make it fair and fun exoerience for all. I believe that I can enforce these rules, and help those who violate the rules to learn from their mistakes. I think I can be their to fulfill the role of the referee position. 
Best time of the week?:Afternoons or Evenings. Weekdays can work for me sometimes, but I'm mostly free all day on weekends. 
A paragraph or two to tell us something about yourself(Pretend you are trying to sell yourself to us): Well I started playing Avicus about 1 1/2-2 years ago. Ever since then I fell in love with Avicus.  I joined the Team Berzerk and slowly rose the ranks of the team to one of the Co-Leaders. I've been an experienced player on Avicus. I know the rules and guidlines for Avicus. So I believe that I would be a great fit for Referee. I've had a lot of leadership roles in my current life. I take my job and role seriously. I'm very good at handling situations and remaining calm in certain instances. When I am in a leadership position, I prioritize my goals and things that I need to get done first and as soon as possible. I think that I could play a great role in building Avicus a nice friendly, fair atmosphere.  
Anything else?:I would just like to say thank you for your time and consideration.
